entrypoints.name: dynGENIE3
entrypoints.mapping: global pooled network; native TS-only and optional steady_state_expression; RF/ET, quality and retained models
entrypoints.reason: Main full-network API preserves independent time-course derivatives before pooling. Native groups/column networks are not exposed.

entrypoints.name: get_link_list
entrypoints.mapping: maxcount export from full-precision VIM; deterministic ties, omit zero scores
entrypoints.reason: ANDREA implements the positive-edge projection itself to preserve magnitudes and avoid six-decimal rounding/random zero-edge permutation.

entrypoints.name: estimate_degradation_rates
entrypoints.reason: No separate estimate-only network job: exact data-derived estimator is retained and resolved rates are exported within main inference.

entrypoints.name: compute_feature_importances
entrypoints.reason: Trained estimator object is not an external serializable input; main inference retains the exact mean unnormalized-importance computation.

entrypoints.name: dynGENIE3_single
entrypoints.reason: Main API iterates all target genes and maps the same public scientific options; arbitrary single-target network jobs are excluded.

entrypoints.name: wr_dynGENIE3_single

entrypoints.name: dynGENIE3_predict_doubleKO

limitations: This frozen preparation dossier declares the user-selected expanded finite panel. Image 1.0.1 passed the earlier 17-case functional matrix; the expanded campaign reruns 26 cases and separately gates 1944 calibration and312 independent prediction allocations. Earlier measurements retain their original provenance and require explicit compatibility verification for reuse.
Source tests and real CLI/browser reviews are retained separately. Source/import/mocked/preflight evidence cannot substitute for physical acceptance of the exact image.

Only observed longitudinal bulk series with explicit canonical temporal declaration are supported; no implicit technical averaging, independent-sample pairing, pseudotime or group/column-native network claims.
Native output is a directed unsigned target-normalized ranking; quality diagnostics are exploratory and undefined values remain null, not biological accuracy or causal proof.
Software license is not explicitly stated for the Python source; paper CC-BY does not establish a software redistribution license. R/MATLAB C code has a distribution-permission notice.

Expanded coverage and independent held-out runtime prediction checks remain separate gates. A measurement allocation or reusable checkpoint does not certify the expanded panel; live acceptance belongs to campaign-expanded-20261021/acceptance/integration.json. No publication is performed.

An accidental approximately six-second dyngen simulation during the broader session was stopped by targeting only the session-owned PIDs/container, reported to the user, and excluded from all dynGENIE3 acceptance/calibration evidence.
External experiment completion is required before every future Docker execution; verifier retains failures/timeouts/interruptions and never treats plan-only placeholder image IDs as executed images.
